title: AI Estate
description: Flagship estate overview: GPU power/thermal, local inference throughput, cloud token/cost flow by provider, and collector lane health.

panels.title: GPU Power Now
panels.description: Live nvidia-smi power draw, the GPU box.

panels.title: GPU Power
panels.description: Power draw of the GPU box. Shares its time axis (and the dashboard's shared crosshair) with Local Token Throughput directly below -- split from a former dual-axis watts+tok/s overlay so each measure keeps one honest axis.

panels.title: Local Token Throughput
panels.description: Prompt (prefill) and generation throughput on one tok/s axis. Both sglang and the documented llama.cpp metric spellings are combined with label-preserving zero fallbacks, so an absent lane cannot hide an active one.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(sglang:prompt_tokens_total[1m])) or sum(rate(llamacpp:prompt_tokens_total[1m]))*0 or sum(rate(llamacpp_prompt_tokens_total[1m]))*0) + (sum(rate(llamacpp:prompt_tokens_total[1m])) or sum(rate(sglang:prompt_tokens_total[1m]))*0 or sum(rate(llamacpp_prompt_tokens_total[1m]))*0) + (sum(rate(llamacpp_prompt_tokens_total[1m])) or sum(rate(sglang:prompt_tokens_total[1m]))*0 or sum(rate(llamacpp:prompt_tokens_total[1m]))*0)

(sum(rate(sglang:generation_tokens_total[1m])) or sum(rate(llamacpp:tokens_predicted_total[1m]))*0 or sum(rate(llamacpp_tokens_predicted_total[1m]))*0) + (sum(rate(llamacpp:tokens_predicted_total[1m])) or sum(rate(sglang:generation_tokens_total[1m]))*0 or sum(rate(llamacpp_tokens_predicted_total[1m]))*0) + (sum(rate(llamacpp_tokens_predicted_total[1m])) or sum(rate(sglang:generation_tokens_total[1m]))*0 or sum(rate(llamacpp:tokens_predicted_total[1m]))*0)

panels.title: Energy Today
panels.description: Energy since local midnight (panel pinned to now/d via timeFrom), computed with MetricsQL integrate() over the actual power samples, divided into kWh. Deliberately NOT avg_over_time(...) * $__range_s: that form extrapolates the sampled average across any unsampled hours, and on a partial-coverage day (exporter or box down for part of the day) it over-reported by ~3.4x, drifting DOWNWARD as idle samples accumulated -- caught live 2026-08-29 against a raw /api/v1/export trapezoid ground truth (integrate() matched within 0.25%). Issued as a range query reduced to its last value, per this project's standing rule for stat panels.

panels.title: VRAM / Temp
panels.description: GPU memory used (left axis, binary bytes) vs die temperature (right axis, deg C).

panels.title: Prompt vs Generation (by model)
panels.description: Five-minute prompt and generation rates by model or active lane. The log10 axis keeps low generation rates visible beside prefill-heavy prompt traffic; zero-rate idle periods are not drawn on a logarithmic axis.

(sum by (model_name)(rate(sglang:generation_tokens_total[5m])) or sum by (model_name)(rate(llamacpp:tokens_predicted_total[5m]))*0 or sum by (model_name)(rate(llamacpp_tokens_predicted_total[5m]))*0) + (sum by (model_name)(rate(llamacpp:tokens_predicted_total[5m])) or sum by (model_name)(rate(sglang:generation_tokens_total[5m]))*0 or sum by (model_name)(rate(llamacpp_tokens_predicted_total[5m]))*0) + (sum by (model_name)(rate(llamacpp_tokens_predicted_total[5m])) or sum by (model_name)(rate(sglang:generation_tokens_total[5m]))*0 or sum by (model_name)(rate(llamacpp:tokens_predicted_total[5m]))*0)

panels.title: Latency (p50 / p95)
panels.description: End-to-end request latency, sglang: histogram (verified live name/labels; llama.cpp lane not yet resident).

panels.title: Daily Tokens by Provider (30d)
panels.description: Stacked daily token deltas per cloud-side provider (hermes excluded -- its client-side view mixes local + cloud-routed traffic and lives in its own attribution panel below, per the spec's anti-double-count rule). Query is a direct two-point counter subtraction -- max_over_time(...) minus its 1d-offset twin, each falling back to a zero-valued series that carries the SAME labels (X or (X*0), not X or vector(0), which has no labels and silently drops any series with no exact match) -- NOT increase(). increase() was verified live against this day-granular pushed data to be unreliable (window-size-dependent, off by up to ~27x); see README troubleshooting.

panels.title: Cost per Day (30d)
panels.description: Daily client-side cost delta per cloud provider. Hermes is excluded to avoid double-counting its mixed local and cloud-routed client view. Uses the same two-point subtraction as the token panels, not increase().

panels.title: Month-to-Date
panels.description: Cumulative tokens since the start of the current calendar month, per cloud-side provider (hermes excluded). Panel time range is pinned to now/M via timeFrom, independent of the dashboard's own 24h default. Deliberately issued as a range query reduced to its last point, not an instant query: verified live that VictoriaMetrics' instant-query path (/api/v1/query) can return a materially wrong result for this same max_over_time+large-offset expression at the exact same evaluation instant an identical range query (/api/v1/query_range) gets exactly right against a raw-export ground truth -- a second, separate reliability finding beyond increase(); see README troubleshooting.

panels.title: Model Breakdown (Top 12, 30d)
panels.description: Top 12 (provider, model) pairs by 30-day token delta across cloud-side providers (hermes excluded -- controller ruling: a ranked table still invites cross-provider comparison/summing by eye, which recreates the double-count the anti-double-count rule prevents, even with each row individually labeled. hermes's per-model breakdown lives exclusively in the Hermes Per-Profile Attribution panel below). Same robust subtraction pattern as the other row-3 panels, issued as a range query reduced to its last value per series (see Month-to-Date's description for why instant mode is avoided).

panels.title: Local vs Cloud Output (24h)
panels.description: Comparable output-token totals for the last 24 hours: server-side local generation versus client-side cloud output, plus local output share. Hermes is excluded from cloud totals to prevent double-counting its mixed routing view. Uses two-point counter subtraction rather than increase().

panels.title: Hermes Client View (30d)
panels.description: Client-side view. Daily token deltas by Hermes model/profile, as reported by tokscale's client-side view of Hermes activity (mixes local-served and cloud-routed-through-Hermes traffic). Deliberately never summed into any cross-provider total on this dashboard -- see the anti-double-count rule. Same robust subtraction pattern as the other day-granular panels, not increase(). Rendered as stacked daily bars: the data is sparse day-granular deltas, which as overlapping lines read as a tangle of spikes over empty space.

panels.title: Collector Lanes
panels.description: Latest status per known collector lane. UP means a successful sample in the last 20 minutes. NOT UP means the latest cycle failed, the lane is unconfigured, or no recent sample exists; a 30-day fallback keeps stale lane labels visible.

panels.title: Collector Freshness
panels.description: Elapsed time since each lane last succeeded. Green is under 15 minutes, yellow is 15-60 minutes, and red is over one hour. A 30-day lookback keeps stopped collectors visible; known lanes that have never succeeded are shown explicitly as NEVER.
